MY STORY

The person behind
the player.

Raleigh roots. A love of competition. And a new way to get back in the game.

01

Growing Up in Raleigh

I grew up in Raleigh, North Carolina, and sports were a big part of my life. I was an active teenager, playing sports throughout childhood and running cross country and track in high school. My personal best in the mile was around 4 minutes and 47 seconds. I loved having something to work toward and a chance to compete.

02

The Summer Everything Changed

When I was 18, during the summer between high school graduation and my freshman year of college, I sustained a spinal cord injury in a diving accident. I was on a mission trip on the island of Eleuthera in the Bahamas.

I was flown to Jackson Memorial Hospital in Miami, where I underwent an 11-hour surgery for a C4–C5 spinal cord injury. After spending roughly one to two months in the ICU, I transferred to the Shepherd Center in Atlanta, Georgia. There, I continued rehabilitation until I was off the ventilator and strong enough to return home.

03

Continuing My Education

Once I was home, I continued my education through online and in-person classes at NC State, Wake Tech, and UNC. Eventually, I earned enough credits to transfer to the University of North Carolina full time, where I graduated with a degree in Management and Society and a minor in Philosophy.

Today, I work in digital content, social media, and marketing for a healthcare practice. I’m also a licensed real estate agent with Cox Distinctive Properties LLC.

04

Finding Competition Again

After my injury, one of the things I missed most was competing. As a quadriplegic who uses a sip-and-puff wheelchair, I struggled to find an activity where I could compete alongside my friends.

Then I started using the QuadStick.

It has changed my life in a meaningful way. Gaming has given me a way to reconnect with the competitive side of myself and spend time doing something I love with my friends. I play games like Halo, Call of Duty, FIFA, and Fortnite, and I love the teamwork, the competition, and the moments we share.

I’ve also discovered how much I enjoy story-driven games, including the Star Wars Jedi series and Hogwarts Legacy.

QuadMann Gaming is where I share that part of my life: the games, the setup, the big plays, and the fun of getting to compete again.
